data.mechanism: When lysosomes are stressed, ULK1 brought in by the adaptor TAX1BP1 (TAX1BP1-ULK1) phosphorylates FNIP1 at S296 on the lysosome. This switches the FLCN-FNIP complex off, so mTORC1 can no longer hold TFEB in the cytoplasm and TFEB moves into the nucleus. TBK1 does the same job on this route and has its own link (TBK1-FNIP1).
data.mechanism_beginner: ULK1 tags FNIP1, which turns FLCN off and lets TFEB escape mTORC1's grip.
data.context: A parallel input to TFEB, not a refutation of canonical TFEB control by mTORC1 (MTORC1-TFEB): it acts by removing FLCN, which mTORC1 needs in order to reach TFEB. This is separate from ULK1's better-known role starting autophagy (ULK1-AUTOPHAGY).
data.boundary: Human cell lines and ATP6V1B2-mutant follicular lymphoma samples (ESP2026); a nutrient-independent lysosomal-stress route in which TBK1 is an alternative kinase. Single study, not yet replicated.
